description: Unit tests for the 'Item Group' doctype in ERPNext, testing nested set operations such as tree structure validation, moving, deleting, merging, and recursion handling.

classes.name: TestItem
classes.description: Test case class for Item Group nested set operations, including tree validation, movement, deletion, merging, and recursion tests.

methods.name: test_basic_tree
methods.description: Validates the nested set properties of Item Group records, ensuring correct lft/rgt values and child counts.

methods.name: get_no_of_children
methods.description: Recursively counts the number of children for a given item group.

methods.name: test_recursion
methods.description: Tests detection of recursive parent-child relationships in item groups.

methods.name: test_rebuild_tree
methods.description: Rebuilds the nested set tree and validates structure.

methods.name: move_it_back
methods.description: Resets the parent of a test item group to root and validates tree structure.

methods.name: test_move_group_into_another
methods.description: Moves a group under another parent and validates nested set adjustments.

methods.name: test_move_group_into_root
methods.description: Attempts to set a group as root and expects an error.

methods.name: print_tree
methods.description: Outputs the current tree structure in JSON format.

methods.name: test_move_leaf_into_another_group
methods.description: Moves a leaf node into another group and validates nested set updates.

methods.name: test_delete_leaf
methods.description: Deletes a leaf node and verifies ancestor rgt values update accordingly.

methods.name: test_delete_group
methods.description: Ensures deletion of a group with children raises an error.

methods.name: test_merge_groups
methods.description: Merges two groups and validates tree structure, then restores original state.

methods.name: test_merge_leaves
methods.description: Merges leaf nodes and validates tree structure.

methods.name: test_merge_leaf_into_group
methods.description: Checks error when merging a leaf into a group.

methods.name: test_merge_group_into_leaf
methods.description: Checks error when merging a group into a leaf.
